text:
Nina: Quick idea - add a 'sample-and-observe' fallback for rollouts. It routes a tiny % to fallback but keeps responses in-band. Tag sampled requests with sample_key and surface in console.
Chris: I like it. We should call out the exact triggers: sustained p99 > 2s for 3m, error_rate > 4% for 5m, or eval drift > 1.5%.
Ravi: Important: sampling must be deterministic so that replay and diffing are stable. Use seed + request_id hash. Also record decision_id in telemetry.
Dana: Console UX: a compact chip in rollout timeline 'sampled fallback active', shows sample rate, sampled RPS, top divergence metric, and button 'open sample panel'.
Nina: API sketch: fallback_mode=sample_observe, sample_rate=0.005, sample_seed="org:proj:rollout:1779997771", bill_as=target. Keep audit retention configurable.
Chris: Edge case: if sampled variant is cheaper but slower, sampling could mask a latency regression. We need auto-revert if sampled p95 > baseline by X% for Y minutes.
Ravi: Telemetry additions: fallback_mode, sample_seed, sample_decision, decision_id, and small hashes (prompt_hash,response_hash) for diffs. Keep them optional.
Dana: Add two operator actions in UI: 'promote sample -> hard fallback' and 'snooze sampling'. Both should append an audit entry with operator, reason, and timestamp.
ops-bot: Recorded: rollout/alpha-canary step added id=rl-2026-03-23-01
Nina: Also propose a replay feature in console: take a sampled request and run against both variants side-by-side (sandboxed). Show token-level diffs and latency. No raw text unless customer opt-in.
Chris: Billing: make billing attribution configurable. Default to 'target' so billing reflects real compute. Add an opt-in flag to bill_as_original for legacy accounting teams.
Ravi: Implementation note: keep sampling decision local at edge so we avoid extra RPCs. Emit a compact trace to the telemetry pipeline.
Dana: QA plan: deterministic sampling unit tests, replay integration tests, and an end-to-end where sample -> detect divergence -> promote -> rollback happens.
Nina: I'll file RFC PR with API shape + minimal telemetry + mockups. Assign Chris for alert rules, Ravi for sampling algorithm, Dana for mockups. Thanks. :)
